description: megabuf and gmegabuf guest memory: indexing, truncation, bounds, and separation. Both buffers hold 1048576 f32 slots and start zero-filled.

cases.name: a value stored in megabuf reads back at the same index
a buffer index truncates toward zero
a write to a negative index is dropped, not an error
a write past the end of the buffer is dropped
cases.note: Out-of-range access is silently ignored at both ends. Presets index buffers with computed values that routinely leave the range.

cases.name: a buffer index is an ordinary expression, so the division guard applies to it
cases.note: 1/0 is 0, so this writes slot 0. A tier that let the index become Infinity would drop the write instead.

cases.name: a buffer slot can be read and written in one statement
megabuf and gmegabuf are separate address spaces
cases.note: megabuf is per-preset scratch; gmegabuf is shared across presets and survives a preset switch.

cases.name: buffer state supplied before the block runs is visible to it
